purpose: Starts the page server on the loopback and opens, through the link, a page Squire made, a Markdown page and the dashboard; reads the stylesheets each links as a browser does and checks the default theme's text, background and links in light and in dark, their contrast and the system font; checks a Markdown page is served formatted; checks the owner's own theme file is used in place of the default; and checks nothing is fetched from another host.
title: Every page Squire serves wears the default theme in light and dark, or the owner's own

testCases.description: a page Squire made, a Markdown page and the dashboard each wear the default theme's text, background and links in light and in dark, at least 4.5 to 1, in the system font
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-theme.test.js::every page Squire serves, the dashboard included, is shown in Squire's default theme in light and in dark: the stylesheet it links gives the default theme's text, background and links in each mode, each at least 4.5 to 1, in the Mac's own system font

testCases.description: a Markdown page is served as a formatted page with headings, list and emphasis, no raw marks left
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-theme.test.js::a Markdown page is shown formatted, never as raw marks: served as a page with its headings, list and emphasis as HTML, and no # or ** left in its text

testCases.description: with the owner's own theme file in their Squire folder, every page uses it in place of the default
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-theme.test.js::when the owner has put a theme file of their own in their Squire folder, every page Squire serves, the dashboard included, uses it in place of the default

testCases.description: no page Squire serves fetches a font, script or style from another host
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-theme.test.js::no page Squire serves fetches a font, a script or a style from any other host: every stylesheet, script and font it names is the page server's own
